buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The EMD must be submitted in the form of a Demand Draft draw n in favour of “JAU FUND ACCOUNT.” Alternatively, bidders may submit a valid EMD exemption certi ficate (if applicable) in accordance with Gujarat State Procurement Policy-2024, Point No. 4(A), alon g with a valid NIC code. Moreover, the soft copy of the EMD must be uploaded on GeM, and the hard copy must reach the Buyer Address within the stipulated time. 2. Manufacturer’s Authorization Form (MAF): The bidder is required to submit a bid-specific Manu facturer’s Authorization Form (MAF) issued by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) for the fo llowing brands. The Buyer reserves the right to verify the authenticity of the MAF directly with the O EM. Submission of forged, false, or fabricated documents will result in immediate disqualification fro m the bidding process. 3. OEM Components Requirement: The monitor, keyboard, and mouse must be of the same OEM m ake as the offered CPU. The OEM logo must be embossed on all components. An undertaking letter f rom the OEM confirming this must be submitted at the time of bidding. 4. OEM Eligibility and Document Verification: The bidder shall specify the OEM name, exact deskt op model and configuration, supported by the official OEM datasheet. The OEM shall provide model- specific drivers, firmware and technical documentation through its official support portal, with the w orking URL shared along with the bid documents. Operating-system recovery/reinstallation support shall be provided wherever applicable. The bidder shall provide evidence of the prescribed OEM-bac ked on-site warranty, service coverage in Junagadh, Gujarat, service response times and escalation mechanism. All submitted documents and claims shall be verifiable and comply with applicable GeM category conditions and procurement rules.

5. Non-Malicious Code Certificate: The OEM and Bidder (both) shall submit a signed certificate conf irming that the offered desktop computer's hardware, firmware and pre-installed software do not co ntain embedded malicious code, malware or Trojans designed to disrupt intended functions, damag e equipment, or access or transmit information without authorisation. The certificate shall identify t he offered product/model and be signed by an authorised representative. The requirement shall be subject to applicable GeM category conditions. 6. Product Datasheet & Technical Compliance: The product datasheet must be publicly available on the OEM’s official website. In case of any unexplained mismatch in the technical specifications, t he bidder is liable to be rejected. An undertaking letter from the bidder must be submitted along wit h the bid to confirm this compliance. 7. Product Model Details: The complete datasheet, including the model name of the offered product , must be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Delivery, Installation, and Testing: The bidder shall ensure comprehensive on-site delivery, inst allation, and testing. Final payment will be released only upon successful and satisfactory completio n of installation and testing activities. 9. Compliance with “Make in India” Initiative: The proposed product must conform to the “Make i n India” guidelines. A detailed product catalogue and datasheet—issued either by the OEM or the bi dder—must be enclosed with the bid. The submitted information may be cross-verified with the official OEM website. Any mismatch or unverifiable data will result in immediate disqualification. 10. Local Office Requirement: The OEM or bidder must have a functional office in the state of Gujarat with a dedicated service and support contact number to ensure prompt assistance and support. 11. Declaration of Non-Blacklisting: Bidders are required to submit a declaration on non-judicial sta mp paper of ₹300/-, certifying that they are not blacklisted by any Government or Semi-Governmen t authority. The declaration also includes unconditional acceptance of all terms and conditions specif ied in the tender document, as outlined in Annexure I. The stamp paper shall be issued and dated after the tender publication date. 12. GeM Rating Criteria: The bidder must have a GeM rating of 4.00 or higher. Any bidder flagged in r ed on the GeM portal shall be disqualified without exception. 13. Right to Cancel: The University reserves the absolute right to cancel the bidding process at any st age, without assigning any reason whatsoever. 14. Non-Acceptance of Late Documents: New or revised documents submitted after the technical bi d opening / representation phase shall not be considered for evaluation. . 3.
